content: Three GitOps secrets patterns dominate: Sealed Secrets (in-cluster controller, kubeseal encrypt, lowest barrier but key loss = secret loss, awkward for disposable clusters), SOPS+age (file-level encryption in git, native Flux integration, needs plugin for ArgoCD), External Secrets Operator (git holds references, values pulled from vault/1Password/Doppler at runtime; best for rebuildable clusters since secrets survive cluster rebuild). Common recommendation: start Sealed Secrets, graduate to ESO when rotation/rebuild matters. For a disposable-cluster design ESO or SOPS is favored because Sealed Secrets couples secret recovery to the cluster's controller key.
